Subject: Q2 board packet: ARR & bookings — pipeline stage cleanup and narrative inputs

Team —

We need a short, audited set of inputs for the board packet next week. Investors want a clear breakout of: net new ARR, recognized bookings for the quarter, and any large one-time professional services revenue treated separately. To keep the deck crisp, please do the following in the attached forecast model and reply-all by EOD Monday (2026-05-18):

1) Stage updates: move any deals that are not confirmed by legal/procurement to "best case" (remove from commit).
2) Commit review: mark deals as "commit" only if sales + finance confirm PO/signed contract or fully executed DocuSign.
3) ARR classification: for each committed deal include: Annualized ARR (net new), Contract start date, and whether it is billed monthly/annual prepay.
4) Outliers: flag deals > $250k ARR and include expected recognition timing (quarter of recognition).
5) Narrative bullet (1-paragraph) that explains variance vs last quarter: wins, delays, churn hotspots.

Attachments: Q2_forecast_model.xlsx (tab: PIPELINE + SUMMARY) and Board_Metrics_Slides_v2.pptx (notes section needs the narrative).

Why: Kestrel asked for a clean, conservative commit number for the board — they want to see committed bookings vs pipeline separately. We should avoid inflating commit in the deck.

Thanks — I will consolidate and send a sanitized summary to the board.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
